LEGAL INFORMATION

Cookie policy

Working document. The cookie inventory for the final environment must be verified before public publication.

1. Scope of this information

This page describes how the Nintec Solutions information website works. It does not describe the technologies used by the Nintec360 platform after subscription.

2. This website redesign

This website does not include analytics, advertising or its own cookies. It stores only your language preference (CA, ES, EN or NL) in your browser’s local storage under the key “nintec-language”. You can change it using the language selector or remove it by clearing the site’s data in your browser.

Access to this private version may use the hosting platform’s authentication mechanisms. The details that apply to the final public environment still need to be verified.

3. Future changes

If analytics, advertising tools or other services are added, this information and consent management will need to be reviewed before they are enabled.

4. Browser settings

You can view and manage stored cookies in your browser’s privacy settings.

5. Contact

For enquiries about this website: info@nintecsolutions.com.
